auth.name: Name
auth.rejectedText: Check the keyboard layout and Caps Lock.

wizard.label: First run
wizard.note: Everything you set here can be changed later in the panel.

account.title: Create the owner account
account.text: You use it to sign in to the panel and set up the server. There is one account per server: the household watches through profiles on the TV.
account.emailHint: Only for signing in. The server sends no email.

account.description: The server owner account. A second one can't be created: the household watches through profiles.
account.nameText: How the panel calls you, for example in the account menu.
account.emailText: Email is only used to sign in: the server sends no email.
account.single: There is one account per server — the owner.

sources.title: Sources
sources.loadErrorText: The server didn't respond. If the panel has been open for a while, reload the page.

empty.title: Connect your first source
empty.text: The server searches for releases in Torznab indexers. Until there are some, the showcase finds movies and series but has nothing to play them from.
empty.importText: All indexers of the manager in one step. Torsher keeps them in sync after that.
empty.manualText: The address and API key of a single indexer, if you have no manager.
empty.foot: Any Torznab indexer works, for example Prowlarr or Jackett. You decide which indexers to enable in it.

progress.title: Checking indexers · {done} of {total}
progress.hint: you can switch to another section

errors.auth: The API key was rejected. Check the key and try again.
errors.timeout: The address didn't respond in time. Check that the service is running and the server can reach it.
errors.unreachable: The Torsher server couldn't reach the address. Check it; if the service runs in a neighbouring container, use its name in the Docker network.
errors.bad_response: The address answered, but not with Torznab. Check the address.
errors.remote: The indexer answered with an error. Check it in its own interface or try later.
errors.unsupported: No manager API at this address. Check the type and the address, or update the manager.

reasons.auth: Key rejected — enter a new key
reasons.timeout: Didn't respond in time — search goes on without it
reasons.unreachable: Unreachable — check the address and network
reasons.bad_response: The response doesn't look like Torznab — check the address
reasons.missing: Gone from {manager} — Torsher searches it but doesn't update it

problems.authManaged: The indexer rejected the API key. Update the key in {manager} — the next sync will pick it up.
problems.auth: The indexer rejected the API key. Enter a new key with “Edit”.
problems.timeout: The indexer didn't respond in time. Search goes through the others and skips this one until it responds.
problems.missing: The indexer is no longer in {manager}. Torsher still searches it but doesn't update it. Delete it if you don't need it.

validation.name: Enter a name
validation.url: Enter an http or https address

indexers.deleteText: The server will stop searching this indexer.
indexers.deleteManagedText: The server will stop searching this indexer. It came from {manager}, so the next sync will add it again. To keep it out of search, disable it here or delete it in {manager}.

managers.synced: Added {added}, updated {updated}, gone from the manager {missing}
managers.importedText: Added {n} indexer. Checking it — the status will update by itself. | Added {n} indexers. Checking them — statuses will update by themselves.
managers.disconnectText: Torsher will stop syncing indexers with
managers.outcome: What to do with the indexers
managers.keepText: They become manual, search keeps working.

importDialog.title: Import from Prowlarr or Jackett
importDialog.description: Torsher adds all indexers of the manager and keeps them in sync.
importDialog.urlHint: The address at which the Torsher server reaches the manager, not this computer.

keyHint.prowlarr: In Prowlarr: Settings → General → API Key.
keyHint.jackett: In Jackett: the API Key field at the top of the dashboard.

addDialog.title: Add a Torznab indexer
addDialog.description: The server checks the indexer before saving it.
addDialog.name: Name
addDialog.apiKeyHint: Leave empty if the indexer needs no key.

editDialog.title: Edit {name}
editDialog.description: The server checks a new key right after saving.
editDialog.apiKeyHint: Leave empty to keep the current key.
